system.description:
Unique feat (a Secret). Once per encounter, as part of an attack, declare it; the attack has Advantage, and on a hit it is a critical hit and the target makes a Fortitude save (10 + half your level + Strength or Dexterity modifier) or is Stunned until the end of its next turn.

It is on no Path, uses no feat level and isn't your Trained Feat for the Tier; once per character. Learned only by studying with its one living holder (the Secret The Last Form).
